levels.name: Informational
levels.impact: No operational impact; informational security event or observation.
levels.evidence_requirement: Basic telemetry, source, timestamp and contextual notes.

levels.name: Low
levels.impact: Minor and bounded security impact with no critical trust boundary affected.
levels.evidence_requirement: Timestamped logs, initial analysis and affected asset identification.

levels.name: Moderate
levels.impact: Localized security impact with potential policy, identity, data or runtime implications.
levels.evidence_requirement: Correlated telemetry, containment status, analyst notes, scope assessment and initial timeline.

levels.name: High
levels.impact: Significant security impact affecting multiple systems, agents, runtime domains or trust boundaries.
levels.evidence_requirement: Comprehensive evidence package, containment actions, detailed timeline, affected boundaries and remediation status.

levels.name: Critical
levels.impact: Critical security impact affecting core governance, production integrity, sensitive data, financial boundaries or system safety.
levels.evidence_requirement: Full forensic evidence package, chain-of-custody records, verified preservation artifacts, containment evidence and governance decision records.
